buildCommand: s="$(pwd)"; d="$s"; while [ ! -f "$d/build.sh" ] || [ ! -f "$d/pubspec.yaml" ]; do if [ "$d" = "/" ]; then echo "build.sh nicht gefunden ab $s"; exit 1; fi; d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; echo "Repo-Wurzel: $d, Vercel-Ordner: $s"; bash "$d/build.sh" && if [ "$d" != "$s" ]; then rm -rf "$s/build" && mkdir -p "$s/build" && cp -r "$d/build/web" "$s/build/web"; fi
